name: Springfield

stay_areas.name: Near the Wonders of Wildlife Museum & Aquarium
stay_areas.best_for: Families working through the aquarium and the Discovery Center of Springfield
stay_areas.why: The Wonders of Wildlife Museum & Aquarium and the Discovery Center of Springfield can take a whole day between them, which is far easier from a central address.

stay_areas.name: The Ozarks edge
stay_areas.best_for: Walkers heading out to the Ozark hills southeast of the city
stay_areas.why: Rooms on the Ozarks side of Springfield cut the drive out to the rougher country and leave the Springfield Art Museum on the far side of the plateau.

stay_areas.name: By the Mediacom Ice Park
stay_areas.best_for: Evenings at the Mediacom Ice Park rather than out on the Springfield Plateau
stay_areas.why: The Mediacom Ice Park keeps a calendar of its own, and the beds nearest it move with that schedule rather than with the season.
